aarti.tek: Perform the āratī of Śrī Rāmalalā, the joy of Raghu's line, perfect in every art.
aarti.pad1: Nārāyaṇa himself came as a man and was called Rāma, the joy of Raghu's line. Kausalyā's son, lotus-eyed, Daśaratha's son, he is Hari, who frees us from the fear of worldly existence. ॥1॥
aarti.pad2: With Bharata, Lakṣmaṇa and Śatrughna, the abode of grace was born in Avadh. He bears bow and arrows and divine weapons; he delights the hearts of the people and dwells in Avadh. ॥2॥
aarti.pad3: He gained learning from his guru Vasiṣṭha and guarded Viśvāmitra's sacrifice. He set Ahalyā free, came to Mithilā and married Janaka's daughter. ॥3॥
aarti.pad4: To keep his father's word he set out for the forest; he slew Rāvaṇa and came back to Avadh. With Sītā he graced the throne and brought Rāma's reign to the three worlds. ॥4॥
aarti.pad5: Glory, glory to him who came as the embodiment of what is right! Glory, glory to the bearer of bow and arrows! Glory to Sītā's lord, glory to the foe of the demons, glory to the chief of the Raghus who dwells in Avadh! ॥5॥
aarti.pad6: The āratī of Rāma and Sītā purifies; it destroys every fault, sorrow and affliction. It pleases the hearts of Śiva, Brahmā, Indra and the saints, and takes away the five ills and the three afflictions. ॥6॥
aarti.pad7: Whoever sets his heart on Rāma's feet and sings his virtues and glory with loving devotion gains undying joy, fame and splendour, and at the end crosses the ocean of worldly existence. ॥7॥
